title: Young Detective
subtitle: "Anytime, anywhere, always serious work!" "Shh, did you hear what he just said?"

items.text: Young Detective
The worn-down factory welcomes a pair of neatly dressed visitors.
Ignoring the workers and their looks, they walk over to an open space by a machine.

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: Here we are.

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: Please watch your step.
A factory filled with a load of run-down machinery. So, what's our mission?

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: To improve the environment here. You need to cleanse this chemical plant with the arcane purification equipment provided.

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: When you're done, you should perform a feasibility test to make sure all the machines are functioning properly.
Me? Do the whole thing?

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: We believe you're competent enough to do so.

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: While you prepare, we'll evacuate the workers and put up a Maze Net to ensure no one is injured or disturbs you.

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: We'll make sure you have a safe and undisturbed working environment, as you stipulated.
Haha. I'm flattered.
By the way, do you smell something funny, like burning fat?

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: No. This place shouldn't have any fat.

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: But when we scouted out the site, we did deploy a number of Stinky Walking Cleaning Balls.
Ah, that must be it. Well, now it smells like stinky socks. Yikes.
Anyway ... Remind me again what we're doing here?

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: Cleansing this chemical plant and performing a feasibility test.

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: These measures are part of an agreement made between the Foundation and a number of severely polluted chemical plants.

items.speaker: Investigator
items.text: More Laplace staff members will come to assist you later.
Please ask them to hurry.
Also, ask them to bring the latest gas masks, will you?
Scout Manual, Safety, Article VI: "Always assess the surroundings before taking action."
With her excellent tracking and concealment skills, Eagle follows the Scout team to the destination of their mission—
A chemical plant in the suburbs.
Amid the employees evacuating the factory, she watches the two members at the back of the Scout team from a distance.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: They're ... staying behind.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: I can't hear them from here ... Should I get closer?
She carefully closes the distance, keeping to the shadows to hide herself.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Alright, now I can hear them.

items.speaker: Boy Scout I
items.text: This place gives me the creeps. Xavier must be really brave to come here!

items.speaker: Boy Scout I
items.text: Mike was right. His secret mission must be a tough one!

items.speaker: Boy Scout II
items.text: What? You really think he hasn't been home for two days because of some secret mission?

items.speaker: Boy Scout II
items.text: Mike isn't a detective, you know. He's just making stuff up!

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: "Secret mission" ...

items.speaker: Boy Scout II
items.text: I still think this is—um, what's the word? A "kidnapping."

items.speaker: Boy Scout I
items.text: Humph, you're so wrong.

items.speaker: Boy Scout I
items.text: Adults always think that if a good boy runs away from home, he must've been kidnapped.

items.speaker: Boy Scout I
items.text: But I don't think so! I think Xavier came here for a secret mission!

items.speaker: Boy Scout I
items.text: To break up a huuuuge evil plan being hatched in an abandoned factory, like in the comic books, you know?

items.speaker: Boy Scout II
items.text: You can't be serious.

items.speaker: Boy Scout II
items.text: If anything breaks, it'll be our noses. This place stinks!

items.speaker: Boy Scout II
items.text: Achoo!

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Something's wrong with the environment here.

items.speaker: Boy Scout I
items.text: Sure does, but whoever finds Xavier will be promoted to team leader! I'll keep searching, even if my nose falls off!

items.speaker: Boy Scout I
items.text: Today's the day I become a team leader! I can feel it!

items.speaker: Boy Scout II
items.text: Then why don't you go to the front of the team? That dummy George might find him first if you don't.

items.speaker: Boy Scout II
items.text: He did win the same number of badges as you for the charity sale.

items.speaker: Boy Scout I
items.text: Hey, I'm staying here to protect you! And just you wait, I'll figure out a way to beat him!

items.speaker: Boy Scout II
items.text: Whatever you say ... I think we've circled back on ourselves now.

items.speaker: Boy Scout I
items.text: I think you're right. Let's catch up with the others.
The boys walk away, still deep in conversation.
Eagle emerges from her hiding place, holding the pocket watch hung around her neck. The light of her arcane skill extends from the watch.
It points in the opposite direction to the boys'.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: They've left. I better hurry too.
Eagle stops herself. Don't rush into things—that's what she learned from the manual.
She takes a deep breath, straightens her bow, and starts forming a mission brief, like a real Scout would do.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Name: Xavier, Sex: male, Age: between 7 and 18 years. Lives with his parents. Last seen around the chemical plant.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: May be on a secret mission.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Whoever finds the missing person will be promoted to team leader of the Scouts team.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: Whoever finds Xavier will be promoted ... Then if I find him, will I have a chance, too?

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: A chance to join the Scouts?
She grasps the pocket watch tighter, as if to gain courage from it.
The light of her arcane skill shines as firmly as the caster's gaze.

items.speaker: Eagle
items.text: I need to find Xavier before they do.
TO BE CONTINUED…
